verdict.rationale: Built-in physics is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. The evidence pack lists Bevy's built-in features (ECS, 2D/3D rendering, animation, UI, scenes, audio, hot reload) but never mentions rigid bodies, collisions or raycasts. Third-party community plugins would not count as built-in capability.

support.subject: As a game developer, built-in physics — rigid bodies, collisions, raycasts — works out of the box
